definition_from_extraction_prompt_v1.4: Canonical standard name (NT BUILD 443, ASTM C1556) only when the source names it or the equivalence is unambiguous; otherwise a concise source-described method such as 'Bulk diffusion (Fick profile fit)'. Required (rule R_06).
Portland cement mass per cubic metre as reported. Derived only from an explicit total and explicit proportion, with mass balance verified. Must be > 0 (rule R_07).
Silica fume mass per cubic metre as reported. Zero only when the source explicitly reports zero dosage; blank when not reported.
Ground-granulated blast-furnace slag mass per cubic metre as reported. Zero only when explicitly reported; blank when not reported.
Fly ash mass per cubic metre as reported. Zero only when explicitly reported; blank when not reported.
Metakaolin mass per cubic metre as reported. Zero only when explicitly reported; blank when not reported.
Mixing water mass per cubic metre as reported.
Reported water-to-total-binder ratio. Derived only when water and every binder component are available. Expected 0.1 to 1.0 (rule R_04, warning).
Natural fine aggregate mass. Direct value, or derived from an explicit aggregate total and an explicit fine-to-coarse or cement-to-fine-to-coarse ratio; otherwise blank.
Natural coarse aggregate mass. Same derivation rule as NFA; otherwise blank.
Superplasticiser mass per cubic metre as reported. Optional; missing must stay blank, never zero.

Compressive strength of the same mixture, preferably at the start of chloride exposure, otherwise at the nearest clearly identified pre-exposure age. No cube-to-cylinder or other conversion unless the source performs it. Optional; if present must be > 0 (rule R_05).

Actual chloride-exposure time in days. Total specimen age and curing-plus-exposure are different quantities and are excluded. Months converted at 30 days only when no exact day count is given. Required > 0 (rule R_03).

Actual chloride-exposure temperature. Curing temperature is an authorised fallback only when exposure temperature is absent, with provenance 'inherited_from_curing'. Time-weighted mean for variable temperatures when interval durations are available. If present, -30 to 100 (rule R_08).

Apparent or effective chloride diffusion coefficient fitted directly to a measured chloride concentration profile (NT BUILD 443, ASTM C1556 or an equivalent bulk-diffusion Fickian profile fit). Migration, RCPT, resistivity, thermodynamic and model-only coefficients are excluded. Reported precision preserved. Every eligible value exported, including Da > 30 (rule R_01 flags, never deletes). Must be > 0 (rule R_02).
DOI when available; otherwise paper title and year. Required (rule R_09).
